text: Kāds vainags Jāņos tradicionāli pienākas vīriešiem?
gloss: What wreath do men traditionally wear at Midsummer (Jāņi)? — One of oak leaves; women wear flower wreaths.

text: Ar ko pildīti klasiskie latviešu pīrādziņi, bez kuriem neiztiek neviens godu galds?
gloss: What fills the classic Latvian pīrādziņi found on every festive table? — Bacon and onion (speķa pīrāgi).

text: Kā turpinās sakāmvārds „Kas pirmais brauc, …”?
gloss: How does the proverb "Whoever drives up first…" go on? — "…grinds first" (at the mill): «Kas pirmais brauc, tas pirmais maļ», first come, first served.

text: Cik zilbju ir vārdā „Ziemassvētki”?
gloss: How many syllables are in "Ziemassvētki" (Christmas)? — 4: Zie-mas-svēt-ki. "ie" is one diphthong, so counting vowel letters gives the trap 5.

text: Kurš okeāns skalo gan Japānas, gan Kalifornijas krastus?
gloss: Which ocean washes both Japan and California? — The Pacific.

text: Kukainim ir sešas kājas. Cik kāju ir zirneklim, kas kukainis nav?
gloss: An insect has six legs. How many does a spider, which is not an insect, have? — Eight: spiders are arachnids.

text: Vilciens izbrauc 9.45 un ceļā pavada pusotru stundu. Cikos tas pienāk galapunktā?
gloss: A train leaves at 9:45 and travels an hour and a half. When does it arrive? — 11:15. 9:45 + 1:30; 11:45 adds two hours, 10:15 only half an hour.

text: Kurā sporta veidā Latvijas izlases bronza 2023. gada pasaules čempionātā deva valstij papildu brīvdienu?
gloss: In which sport did Latvia's bronze at the 2023 world championship earn the country an extra day off? — Ice hockey: after beating the USA, the government declared 29 May 2023 a holiday.

text: Cik stīgu ir parastai klasiskajai ģitārai?
gloss: How many strings does an ordinary classical guitar have? — Six.

text: Kā sauc Astridas Lindgrēnes varoni, kurš dzīvo uz jumta un lido ar propelleri mugurā?
gloss: What is the name of Astrid Lindgren's hero who lives on the roof and flies with a propeller on his back? — Karlsson (Karlsson-on-the-Roof). Emil, Mio and Rasmus are her other heroes.

text: Kuras valsts imperators bija Napoleons Bonaparts?
gloss: Of which country was Napoleon Bonaparte emperor? — France (Emperor of the French, 1804–1814/15).

text: Kā sauc runājošo sniegavīru Disneja multfilmā par māsām Elzu un Annu?
gloss: What is the talking snowman called in Disney's film about the sisters Elsa and Anna (Frozen)? — Olaf. Sven is the reindeer, Hans the prince, Kristoff the ice harvester.

text: Kuras divas krāsas jāsajauc, lai iegūtu zaļu?
gloss: Which two colours do you mix to get green? — Yellow and blue. Red and blue give purple, yellow and red orange.

text: Kurš sengrieķu varonis bija neievainojams visur, izņemot papēdi?
gloss: Which Greek hero was invulnerable everywhere except his heel? — Achilles.

text: Kura pilsēta stiepjas vairāk nekā 30 km garā, šaurā joslā starp Lielupi un jūru?
gloss: Which town stretches for over 30 km in a narrow strip between the Lielupe river and the sea? — Jūrmala (about 32 km long).

text: Kura gāze rada burbulīšus limonādē un minerālūdenī?
gloss: Which gas makes the bubbles in soft drinks and sparkling water? — Carbon dioxide.

text: Ko dara cilvēks, kurš „tur mēli aiz zobiem”?
gloss: What is a person doing who "keeps the tongue behind the teeth"? — Keeping quiet: the idiom «turēt mēli aiz zobiem».

text: Kas spēlē „Angry Birds” zog dusmīgo putnu olas?
gloss: Who steals the angry birds' eggs in "Angry Birds"? — The green pigs.

text: Kurā sporta veidā sacenšas Vimbldonas turnīrā?
gloss: In which sport is the Wimbledon tournament played? — Tennis.

text: No kā gatavo meksikāņu mērci gvakamoli?
gloss: What is the Mexican dip guacamole made from? — Avocado.

text: Kurš putns Latvijā mēdz ligzdot uz stabiem un jumtiem, un tā atlidošana vēsta pavasari?
gloss: Which bird in Latvia nests on poles and roofs, its return heralding spring? — The white stork. Cranes and swans nest on the ground, herons in trees.

text: Ziemassvētku vakars ir 24. decembrī. Cik dienas vēlāk ir Vecgada vakars?
gloss: Christmas Eve is on 24 December. How many days later is New Year's Eve? — 7: 31 − 24. 8 catches those who count both ends.

text: Kurš no šiem vārdiem, izlasīts no otra gala, arī ir latviešu vārds?
gloss: Which of these words, read backwards, is also a Latvian word? — "Sala" (island) gives "alas" (caves). The others give ajām, sviz, sdlag.

text: Kāda bija Latvijas nauda pirms eiro ieviešanas 2014. gadā?
gloss: What was Latvia's currency before the euro arrived in 2014? — The lats. The litas was Lithuania's, the kroon Estonia's.

text: Kāds putns tradicionāli rotā Rīgas vecpilsētas baznīcu torņu smailes?
gloss: What bird traditionally tops the church spires of Riga's Old Town? — The rooster (weathercocks on the Dome, St Peter's and St James's).

text: Cik bieži parasti notiek Vispārējie latviešu Dziesmu un deju svētki?
gloss: How often is the Latvian Song and Dance Festival usually held? — Every five years (e.g. 2018, 2023).

text: Kuros svētkos Latvijā olas tradicionāli krāso sīpolu mizās?
gloss: At which holiday are eggs traditionally dyed in onion skins in Latvia? — Easter.

text: Kurš uzņēmums izstrādā viedtālruņu operētājsistēmu Android?
gloss: Which company develops the Android smartphone operating system? — Google. Samsung makes Android phones but not the system.

text: Tikai ap 312 metriem virs jūras: kurš ir Latvijas augstākais kalns?
gloss: Only about 312 m above sea level: which is Latvia's highest hill? — Gaiziņkalns (311.9 m).

text: Kurš zieds ir Latvijas nacionālā puķe?
gloss: Which flower is Latvia's national flower? — The oxeye daisy (pīpene). The cornflower is Estonia's national flower.

text: Kuru Rīgas ēku ļaudis mēdz dēvēt par „Staļina kūku”?
gloss: Which Riga building do people call "Stalin's cake"? — The Academy of Sciences high-rise (1950s Stalinist style).

text: Kurš sociālais tīkls sākotnēji ļāva rakstīt ne vairāk kā 140 zīmes garus ierakstus?
gloss: Which social network originally limited posts to 140 characters? — Twitter (raised to 280 in 2017).

text: Kurš skaitlis turpina virkni 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, …?
gloss: Which number continues 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8…? — 13: each number is the sum of the previous two (5 + 8).

text: Kurš gads romiešu ciparos rakstāms MMXXV?
gloss: Which year is MMXXV in Roman numerals? — 2025: MM = 2000, XX = 20, V = 5.

text: Ar ko pildīts kurzemnieku sklandrausis?
gloss: What fills the Courland sklandrausis? — Potato and carrot (a rye-dough tart, EU-protected traditional speciality).

text: Kura gāze veido gandrīz četras piektdaļas no gaisa, ko elpojam?
gloss: Which gas makes up nearly four fifths of the air we breathe? — Nitrogen (about 78%). Oxygen is about 21%.

text: Kuru dievieti latviešu dainās piesauc kā govju un piena sargātāju?
gloss: Which goddess do Latvian folk songs invoke as the protector of cows and milk? — Māra. Laima and Dēkla are fate goddesses, Saule the Sun.

text: Kurā pilsētā atrodas Karosta, kas celta kā cara laika kara osta?
gloss: Which city is home to Karosta, built as a tsarist naval port? — Liepāja.

text: Kurā Londonas ielā dzīvoja Šerloks Holmss?
gloss: On which London street did Sherlock Holmes live? — Baker Street (221B).

text: Kuram no šiem vārdiem nav vienskaitļa formas?
gloss: Which of these words has no singular form? — "Durvis" (door) is plural-only; logs, siena, grīda all have singulars. Try forming each singular.

text: Kura valsts 1896. gadā uzņēma pirmās mūsdienu olimpiskās spēles?
gloss: Which country hosted the first modern Olympic Games in 1896? — Greece (Athens). France is the trap: Coubertin was French and Paris hosted in 1900.

text: Kurš režisors uzņēma „Juras laikmeta parku”?
gloss: Who directed "Jurassic Park"? — Steven Spielberg (1993).

text: Rīga 2001. gadā svinēja 800 gadu jubileju. Kurā gadsimtā tā tika dibināta?
gloss: Riga celebrated its 800th anniversary in 2001. In which century was it founded? — The 13th: 1201 falls in the 13th century. "12th" catches autopilot.

text: Kurš ir mazākais pirmskaitlis, kas lielāks par 20?
gloss: What is the smallest prime greater than 20? — 23. 21 = 3 × 7, 25 = 5 × 5, 27 = 3 × 9.

text: Kurš romāns sākas ar vārdiem „Visas laimīgās ģimenes ir līdzīgas…”?
gloss: Which novel opens with "All happy families are alike…"? — Tolstoy's "Anna Karenina".

text: Kurš ir dziļākais Latvijas ezers?
gloss: Which is Latvia's deepest lake? — Drīdzis (about 65 m). Lubāns is the largest by area but shallow; Rāzna the largest by volume.

text: Kā sauca pirmo mākslīgo Zemes pavadoni, kas 1957. gadā devās orbītā?
gloss: What was the first artificial Earth satellite, launched in 1957? — Sputnik (1). Vostok carried Gagarin, Explorer was the first US satellite, Salyut a space station.

text: Kurš Rīgā dzimušais inženieris tiek uzskatīts par vienu no raķešu tehnikas pionieriem?
gloss: Which Riga-born engineer is counted among the pioneers of rocketry? — Friedrich Zander (born in Riga, 1887). Tsiolkovsky, Korolev and Oberth were born elsewhere.

text: Kura ķīmiskā elementa simbols ir Hg?
gloss: Which element has the symbol Hg? — Mercury, from Latin hydrargyrum. Helium is He, hafnium Hf, holmium Ho.

text: Kurš Rīgā dzimušais domātājs kļuva slavens ar eseju „Ezis un lapsa”?
gloss: Which Riga-born thinker became famous for the essay "The Hedgehog and the Fox"? — Isaiah Berlin (born in Riga, 1909). Arendt was born near Hanover, Popper and Wittgenstein in Vienna.
